campaignLoadError: Campaigns could not be loaded from this store.
publishUnavailable: SHOPLINE discount publication is not connected yet
translationSubtitle: Only languages enabled for this store appear here.
translationFallback: Original storefront copy is available below. Connect the store language list to edit translations.
translationUnavailable: Storefront languages are unavailable. Original copy remains visible but editing is disabled.
widgetPageDetail: Adjust the offer treatment and inspect its storefront behavior before publishing.
widgetAppearanceDetail: Changes apply to the live preview.
widgetVariantsDetail: Every selected quantity expands inside its active offer card.
widgetMixedDetail: Count different SKUs within the same product.
widgetSelectorsDetail: Allow each item to choose its own available SKU.
widgetStockDetail: Show remaining stock; sold-out choices remain unavailable.
widgetPricesDetail: Keep the comparison price and estimated savings visible.
widgetImagesDetail: Use the product's variant images for each item.
widgetColorValueDetail: Place the color value below each image.
widgetStockWarning: Remaining-stock labels are hidden; sold-out choices remain disabled.
feedbackShareIntro: Share your ideas and decide what to build next with other merchants.
feedbackLoadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
feedbackEmptyBody: Try a different search term or status.
feedbackReviewNotice: Suggestion submitted. It will be public after review.
feedbackPendingHint: This suggestion is awaiting review and will be visible after approval.
feedbackNoDiscussion: No discussion yet. Share your thoughts.
feedbackWithdrawConfirmContent: Do you want to withdraw this suggestion?
translationUsageTitle: At the top of the widget; saving an empty title hides it.
translationUsageSavingsBadge: Beside a tier title when the savings badge is enabled and that tier has savings.
translationUsageUnused: Not displayed in the current storefront widget.
translationUsageSummary: Above the cart button when price summary is enabled and selected variants are sellable.
translationUsageAdd: On the cart button during normal selection.
translationUsageAdding: Below the cart button while adding items.
translationUsageFailure: Below the cart button when adding items fails.
translationUsageSuccess: Below the cart button after items are successfully added.
translationUsageNoStock: Below the cart button when selections are invalid or unsellable, or SHOPLINE rejects the add because stock is insufficient.
translationUsageSoldOut: On the cart button when a selected variant is sold out; also in enabled cart item details.
translationUsageCheckout: In place of an amount, and below the summary, when the widget cannot calculate a total.
translationUsageChoice: In a variant dropdown before a value is selected.
translationUsageTier: As the tier title when the campaign has no custom title for that tier.
translationUsageUncertain: Below the cart button when the cart result cannot be confirmed; check the cart before retrying.
